'''Butcherbugs''' were a very small [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceal]] [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].

==Description==
Butcherbugs lived in the lower parts of Dagobah's jungle, spinning very sharp, micro-fine webs between fallen branches and [[Tree/Legends|tree]] roots (including the roots of adult [[Gnarltree/Legends|gnarltrees]]) to snare and slice prey, like [[Jubba bird/Legends|Jubba Bird]]s, to bits. The web was so sharp that it was invisible to the naked [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. Because of their small size, butcherbugs were prey for a number of larger species, such as [[Lesser Bogwing|lesser bogwings]]. Covered in a bright green chitinous shell, the butcherbug's two interlocking mandibles could be used to pick up and tear flesh.

A similar species of butcherbugs were found on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], as the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] complained of having to wipe the arachnids from the windscreen of his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Havoc (starfighter)|''Havoc'']].
